description: Add a Save contact button: visitors tap it and their phone offers to add the owner to its contacts (a vCard). One per page. Needs a phone number, email, website, address or weekly times. The name defaults to the page's name, and the website to the page's own link (pass "" for none). It can also show weekly times, like a church's service times or a shop's opening hours (times): days are 0 = Sunday to 6 = Saturday, times are 24-hour "HH:MM" in an IANA time zone. Everything on it is public, so only add details the owner wants anyone to save. Change it later with update_block (title is the name).

address.description: A city or full address, on one line. Shown with the weekly times.

dialCode.description: Country code for the phone number, like "+44". Defaults to "+1".

endsAt.description: When it stops showing, ISO 8601 with a time zone, e.g. 2026-12-01T18:00:00-08:00. Ask the user's time zone if unsure. null clears it.

name.description: The name on the card; defaults to the page's name.

phone.description: A phone number. Without a + it is taken as a US number unless dialCode is given.

startsAt.description: When it starts showing, ISO 8601 with a time zone, e.g. 2026-12-01T18:00:00-08:00. Ask the user's time zone if unsure. null clears it.

times.description: Weekly times shown on the card, such as service times or opening hours. Visitors see them on the page; search engines and AI assistants can read them.

entries.description: One entry per time, up to 20: a day with two services has two entries. [] removes the times.

day.description: 0 = Sunday, 1 = Monday, 2 = Tuesday, 3 = Wednesday, 4 = Thursday, 5 = Friday, 6 = Saturday.

end.description: Optional 24-hour "HH:MM" end. An end before the start runs past midnight.

timeZone.description: The IANA time zone the times are in, named for a place, like "America/Chicago" or "Europe/London" (or "UTC"). Not an abbreviation like "EST" or an offset. Ask the user if unsure.

title.description: Shown above the times, like "Service times", "Mass times" or "Hours". Defaults to "Service times".

website.description: Defaults to the page's own link; "" for none.

name: add_contact_card
title: Add a contact card
